text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
All right, did everyone finish their 
homework? I'm going to collect it now~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(...Well, I actually studied this time. 
Prepare to be amazed by my genius 
answers—)

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Did you actually show up, Sweep-san? 
Otherwise, you'd end up in remedial 
classes, after all."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I was just about to hand it in, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm quitting! And I won't take 
remedial classes either! So theeeere!!

With Sweep Tosho in a terrible mood, the 
training session that followed was a total 
disaster...
